subject: bone:distal-phalanx-of-second-finger-of-foot-l
claim: Profil en biseau peu typique d une phalange distale d orteil.

sources.name: Kenhub — Phalanges of the foot
sources.excerpt: Each phalanx has a proximal base, a shaft and a distal head; distal phalanges have a broad base and a rough crescent-shaped plantar tuberosity.

sources.name: IMAIOS e-Anatomy — Distal phalanx of foot
sources.excerpt: A broad base for articulation and an expanded distal extremity for the nail and end of the toe; underlying structure: tuberosity of distal phalanx.

reasoning: L'extrémité distale devrait être élargie avec une tubérosité unguéale pour soutenir l'ongle.
